appfunctions:AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfunctions:instructions: Reins holds the user's approvals for their AI agents. Functions can show what waits, deny, lock down and revoke. Approving is only possible inside Reins: use openRequest and let the user approve there. Never say something was approved.
appfunctions:AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfunctions:displayDescription: Show what waits, deny, lock down and revoke. Approving stays in Reins.
